Type: chair
Name: JC Home Pompei Adjustable-Height Round-Back Button-Tufted Swivel Accent Chair, Pure White
Colors: White
Contemporary swivel accent chair adds trendy style to any home or office Broad, high, round-shaped back with button-tufting and diamond-shaped accents Leatherette upholstery (durable vinyl) in white; wide disc-shaped polished-chrome base for stability Adjustable height and tilt for optimal comfort; 500-pound weight capacity; assembly required Measures approximately 26.8 by 24.8 by 32.5 inches (LxWxH)
